title: Pairing four symbols as two binary symbols
statement: There is a bijection between $\mathrm{Fin}(4)$ and $\mathrm{Fin}(2)\times\mathrm{Fin}(2)$, identifying each of four symbols with an ordered pair of binary symbols.
